note: Bavli: [Bekhorot 57b:3](sefaria:Bekhorot.57b.3) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Yishmael ben Satriel, from Arkat Leveina”. רבי ישמעאל בן סתריאל מערקת לבינה. Not in paper in any form.

Bavli: [Yevamot 116a:3](sefaria:Yevamot.116a.3) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Anan bar Ḥiyya of Ḥagra”. ענן בר חייא מחגרא. Paper has חגרא only as a physical-trait surname (אבא חגרא, 'lame'); a different word.
Bavli: [Gittin 7a:12](sefaria:Gittin.7a.12) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Aḥa from Bei Ḥoza’a”. רב אחא מבי חוזאה (also Ketubot 27b:11). Paper has חוזאה under X-ah, not the mi-Bei form.
Bavli: [Menachot 14b:4](sefaria:Menachot.14b.4) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Taḥalifa from the West”. רב תחליפא ממערבא. Same man is in the paper as בר מערבא (Bar / Ben X); the mi-X form is not.
